headlines.title: Rescuers search collapsed hospitals for patients trapped by Colombia quake
headlines.summary: Dogs and drones were deployed to search for survivors. At least 220 people were reported dead in the nation’s strongest earthquake in a decade.

headlines.title: Pentagon report reveals steep civilian toll of Trump’s Yemen campaign
headlines.summary: The military operation was the first following Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s dismantling of an office focused on mitigating unintended casualties.

headlines.title: Severe malnutrition in Somalia is surging after U.S. cuts, aid groups say
headlines.summary: “What we are seeing is shocking and far beyond the threshold of an extremely critical emergency,” one humanitarian official said.

headlines.title: 30,000 pounds of beef from Argentina recalled in two states
headlines.summary: A recall of beef products from Corte Argentino USA affects retailers and grocery distributors in Texas and Florida.

headlines.title: Russia releases ailing former Marine imprisoned since 2022
headlines.summary: Robert Gilman and his mother were on a plane back to Washington on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Six killed in Houthi attack on Bab al-Mandeb ship, Yemen’s government says
headlines.summary: Deaths on Egyptian-owned Tihamah mark first shipping deaths linked to Houthis since the US-Israel war on Iran began.

headlines.title: Iran holds firm on Hormuz conditions as Pakistan’s Naqvi visits Tehran
headlines.summary: Iran's top security official says the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen unless the US meets its conditions.

headlines.title: Zambia to vote as economic hardship tests government reforms
headlines.summary: Debt restructuring, inflation and copper revenues are emerging as key issues in the vote.

headlines.title: N Korea launches ballistic missile as S Korea, US plan military drills
headlines.summary: Pyongyang conducts second weapons test in less than a week as Seoul, Washington gear up for annual military exercises.

headlines.title: Trump says US in ‘total control’ of Strait of Hormuz
headlines.summary: Qatar says negotiations between Oman, Iran over future of shipping through Strait of Hormuz are making major progress.

headlines.title: Progressive Peggy Flanagan wins Democratic Senate primary in Minnesota
headlines.summary: Progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan won the Democratic primary for Senate from Minnesota. It continues a series of wins for the progressive wing of the party over centrists.

headlines.title: Trump-backed Mike Lindell loses primary for Minnesota governor to Lisa Demuth
headlines.summary: Lindell had President Trump's endorsement but he lost to Lisa Demuth, the speaker of the state house. She'll face Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar in the fall for governor.

headlines.title: In South Carolina, Sen. Darline Graham advances to a GOP special primary runoff for U.S. Senate
headlines.summary: Sen. Darline Graham, who is serving out the remainder of her brother's term, and Rep. Ralph Norman advance to the special primary runoff later this month.

headlines.title: The death toll climbs from Monday's 7.4 magnitude earthquake in Colombia
headlines.summary: Hundreds of rescue workers have been deployed in hardest hit cities trying to free victims still trapped under the rubble. Hundreds of people are still missing.

headlines.title: A judge expands a block on U.S. Postal Service work on Trump's mail-in voting order
headlines.summary: A federal judge expanded a block on a key part of President Trump's order to restrict mail-in voting for this fall's midterms, banning the Postal Service from carrying out directives in every state.

headlines.title: Colombia quake death toll rises to 188
headlines.summary: BOGOTA -- The death toll from Monday's 7.4-magnitude earthquake in western Colombia has risen to 188, with 1,677 others injured, the Colombian Association of Capital Cities, or Asocapitales, said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Trade tensions strain EU-US ties
headlines.summary: Editor's note: Amid shifting global geopolitics in recent decades, the trans-Atlantic bond is being reshaped. China Daily will present a special series to examine these shifts and their long-term implications.

headlines.title: Turkiye MPs back law to reintegrate Kurdish militants
headlines.summary: ANKARA — Turkiye's parliament on Monday approved a legal framework for the disarmament and reintegration of the Kurdistan Workers' Party, or PKK, a landmark step toward ending a decades-long conflict.

headlines.title: 'Sing for Africa' Season 2 returns with focus on female talent
headlines.summary: Sing for Africa , a China-Kenya music talent show that seeks to discover and nurture young African musicians, has returned for a second season, shifting its focus from the all-male lineup of its inaugural season to young female talent.

headlines.title: Trump demands Iran reparations
headlines.summary: United States President Donald Trump has clapped back at Iran in a counter-demand seeking financial compensation for all of Tehran's alleged damage over the last 50 years, in a fresh war of words as Washington struggles to maintain leverage over the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: SC asks EC to furnish data on SIR appeal disposal in West Bengal
headlines.summary: Supreme Court questions binding timelines for SIR Tribunals while seeking disposal rate details from the Election Commission.

headlines.title: Supreme Court asks government to consider plea for emergency response to deepfake crimes
headlines.summary: Supreme Court urges government to establish urgent measures against online threats, including deepfake crimes and digital harm.

headlines.title: Post-Mecca joint defence pact, India says it will protect its national interests
headlines.summary: India vows to protect its national interests following the Mecca Joint Defence Pact among Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan.

headlines.title: Nagaland CM urges Shah to reconsider FCRA amendments, seeks parliamentary panel review
headlines.summary: Nagaland CM Neiphiu Rio urges reconsideration of FCRA amendments, highlighting their impact on churches and social welfare programs.

headlines.title: Panel seeks enhanced relief, counselling for SC/ST victims
headlines.summary: Government task force proposes increased relief for SC/ST atrocity victims and introduces measures for counselling and protection against counter FIRs.

With Mojo 1.0, developers can now build for the long-term on a stable, production-ready language foundation.
